sections.heading: MIDC Tarapur and Boisar: An API Belt in Palghar District
paragraphs: MIDC Tarapur, next to Boisar in Palghar district, is home to bulk drug and chemical units rather than finished-dose plants, so tube enquiries from here are driven by reactors, solvent recovery and purified-water systems for API crystallisation and drying.

Lupin lists its Tarapur site at T-142, MIDC Tarapur, Boisar (West), where it makes fermentation-based and synthetic active pharmaceutical ingredients. That combination of fermentation and chemistry on one plot is typical of the estate.

The Lupin site's postal code is 401 506. Enquiries from Boisar and the surrounding MIDC plots are handled exactly like Mumbai orders, with the same certificates and the same 24-hour quotation turnaround.

sections.heading: Anupran Industries' Proposed API Unit on Plot E-8
paragraphs: In February 2025 Project X India reported plans by Anupran Industries for an API and intermediates unit at Plot E-8, MIDC Tarapur, Boisar West. The proposal covers a plot of 8,105 sq m with 20,736 sq m of built-up area and 3,242 sq m of green belt, for a capacity of 597.2 tonnes per annum at an estimated cost of Rs 55.68 crore.
Greenfield units like this are where pipe specifications are fixed early, before fabricators are appointed, so getting the grade and finish right in the tender saves rework later.

sections.heading: Fermentation, Solvent and Water Lines in Tarapur: 316L SF1 or SF4
paragraphs: Fermentation media, seed transfer and sterile-air lines in a Tarapur API block are cleaned and steamed in place, and a smoother bore cuts contamination risk; 316L to ASTM A270 with SF4 electropolishing per ASME BPE suits seed and harvest lines, while SF1 is usually enough for media make-up.

Solvent headers, distillation and recovery lines value wall thickness and corrosion resistance over polish, so 316L pipe to ASTM A312 is the normal call, and 904L supplied electropolished is worth pricing where chlorides or acids are present. Maharashtra FDA and CDSCO apply Schedule M to API sites too, and a heat-traced certificate on each length eases those audits.

sections.heading: What a Tarapur Enquiry Needs
paragraphs: Split the line list into fermentation, synthesis, solvent recovery, purified water and utilities, give OD, wall and metres for each, and state grade and finish. Note any line that sees acids or chlorides so we can price 904L alongside 316L.

We send an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to the heat number and an internal Ra report with every electropolished lot, with PMI on every length. Size ranges are on the electropolished pipes and electropolished tubes pages, and a full enquiry is quoted within 24 hours.
bullets: Process area per line: fermentation, synthesis, solvent recovery, crystallisation and drying, purified water or utilities
Media each line carries, with any acids, chlorides or solvents noted
OD by wall and metres per size, plus bends, tees and reducers to quote with the pipe
Grade (304L, 316L or 904L), finish (SF1, SF4 or mill) and the governing standard (ASTM A312, A270 or A269)
For greenfield projects on a new MIDC plot, the tender stage and the fabricator if already appointed

sections.heading: Delivery to Tarapur and Boisar
paragraphs: Tarapur is a short road run north from Mumbai, and tube is packed with caps and sleeves for the trip; dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation.
